engine.help: Enyo UCI engine executable or checkout directory available on all workers

games.help: Total self-play games across all shards; must be even

shards.help: Number of Forge shards; defaults to at least four times the configured worker slots and about 750 games per shard

hash.help: Hash size in MiB for each engine process

tc.help: Fastchess time control; ignored when depth or nodes is set

depth.help: Fixed search depth per move (fastchess tc=inf depth=N); takes priority over nodes and tc

nodes.help: Fixed node budget per move (fastchess tc=inf nodes=N); used when depth is unset, takes priority over tc

uci.help: Common UCI option applied to both self-play engines as NAME=VALUE; repeatable

commands.name: engine
commands.command:
engine={engine}; if probe=$(printf '%s
' uci quit | "$engine" 2>/dev/null) && printf '%s
' "$probe" | grep -q uciok; then printf '%s
' "$probe"; exit 0; fi; name=$(basename "$engine"); case "$name" in enyo_*) commit=$(printf '%s
' "$name" | sed 's/^enyo_//') ;; *) echo "engine is unavailable and cannot be built automatically: $engine" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac; repo=~/code/cpp/chess/enyo; git -C "$repo" fetch origin && if git -C "$repo" rev-parse --verify "$commit^{{commit}}" >/dev/null; then :; else echo "engine $engine is missing and Enyo commit $commit is unavailable in $repo; push/fetch the commit or sync a prebuilt engine to $engine" >&2; exit 1; fi; worktree="$HOME/.cache/forge/enyo-worktrees/$commit-$$"; mkdir -p "$(dirname "$worktree")" && git -C "$repo" worktree add --detach "$worktree" "$commit" && trap 'git -C "$repo" worktree remove --force "$worktree" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' 0 && cd "$worktree" && ./scripts/deploy.sh --candidate && if test -x "$engine"; then printf '%s
' uci quit | "$engine"; else echo "engine build completed but did not create executable: $engine" >&2; exit 1; fi

task.label: selfplay:{shard}
task.command: {fastchess_shell} -engine cmd={engine_shell} name=enyo-a option.Hash={hash} option.Threads={threads} {uci_args} -engine cmd={engine_shell} name=enyo-b option.Hash={hash} option.Threads={threads} {uci_args} -each {limit_args} proto=uci restart={restart_shell} -rounds {shard_pairs} -games 2 -recover -openings file={book_shell} format=epd order={book_order_shell} -srand {seed} -concurrency {concurrency} -pgnout file="{output_dir}/{task_name}.pgn" notation={pgn_notation_shell} -output format=fastchess
